name: io.github.aleksskoz/kubedrive
title: KubeDrive
description: Your Kubernetes clusters for AI agents through the KubeDrive desktop app, without a kubeconfig.

environmentVariables.name: KUBEDRIVE_MCP_TOKEN

environmentVariables.name: KUBEDRIVE_MCP_URL
environmentVariables.description: KubeDrive's MCP endpoint, only if its port was changed
